events.title: LIMINOID - Early Access Release Announcement
events.summary: Hello liminal space fans! Thrilled to announce that LIMINOID releases November 4, 2026

events.title: Demo Update: Localization Support and Bug Fixes
events.summary: The latest demo update brings several bug fixes, improvements and localization support!Demo patch notes:Fixed a bug where the glow from the glowing houses in the HUB randomly disappears.Fixed a bug where the player could move while sitting on a chair or stool.Fixed a bug with the depth of field not clearing when out of focus.Fixed a bug where the mouse disappears and loses focus in the main menu.Improved the interaction system, making it more accurate and precise to where the camera is looking.

events.title: Demo Update: New area, plus an ending
events.summary: With the latest update on the demo, a new area has been added and an actual ending in the poolrooms. Also several bug fixes and improvements.Fixed camera rotation bug when pushed to the highest point.Fixed interaction response with some props.Fixed a bug where the camera distortion wind isn't stopping when auto sprint is on.Fixed a bug where UI interaction is not responsive while VHS mode in on.Improved physical interaction with the physics props.Improved underwater sound quality.

events.title: LIMINOID demo is out!
events.summary: LIMINOID is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.The demo includes a sub-chapter (HUB) and a small part from one of the main chapters, as well as all of the current features and settings.Key FeaturesRewind feature. Since the perspective is from found footage, you can rewind at any moment for as much as possible, as long as the tape is not empty.Swimmin
